changes.comment: The package default export is now the built-in Feishu plugin factory, which contributes the `feishu` channel provider and publishes an extension api for other plugins (tools, card actions, a per-instance lifecycle, and an instance api). `createFeishuChannelProvider` is unchanged. A config that addresses this package as a channel provider through `npm:@excitedjs/feishu-channel` now fails provider loading, because the default export is no longer a provider factory; use `builtin:feishu`.
